content.text: Jupiter Albufeira is a family all-inclusive hotel in Montechoro, east of Albufeira's old town, and two short courses are close by: [Balaia](/courses/balaia) is about **8 minutes** away and [Pine Cliffs](/courses/pine-cliffs) about 13. For 18 holes, [Salgados](/courses/salgados) and the Vilamoura courses [Laguna](/courses/vilamoura-laguna) and [Millennium](/courses/vilamoura-millennium) are about 19 minutes away. **Last checked: November 2026.**

content.text: The nearest courses at a glance
Slope ratings are from the Portuguese Golf Federation for the back tees: the higher the number, the harder the course for an average golfer.
**[Balaia](/courses/balaia)** (9 holes, par 27, 984 m): a short course of par 3s, €50 to play. The resort says a handicap is required, without giving a limit.

**[Pine Cliffs](/courses/pine-cliffs)** (9 holes, par 32, 2,227 m): Martin Hawtree's clifftop course at Olhos de Água, famous for its 6th, the Devil's Parlour. No handicap needed: players without one tee off from the red markers.

**[Salgados](/courses/salgados)** (par 72, 6,033 m, slope 129): flat and one of the easiest courses in the Algarve to walk, on the wetlands behind Praia da Galé, but with plenty of water and exposed to the wind. Twilight rounds start at €47.

**[Vilamoura Laguna](/courses/vilamoura-laguna)** (par 72, 6,121 m, slope 135): flatter and more open than the pine-lined courses, with plenty of water. Vilamoura Golf has a free shared buggy offer on Laguna for new bookings made by 31 December 2026.

**[Vilamoura Millennium](/courses/vilamoura-millennium)** (par 72, 6,176 m, slope 130): Martin Hawtree's flat course with wide fairways, the easiest Vilamoura course on slope. Laguna and Millennium share the lowest green fees in Vilamoura, from €88.

**[Vilamoura Old Course](/courses/vilamoura-old-course)** (par 73, 6,254 m, slope 136): Pennink's 1969 original and Vilamoura's most famous course, lined with umbrella pines, and its most expensive round.

**[Amendoeira Faldo](/courses/amendoeira-faldo)** (par 72, 6,598 m, slope 142): Nick Faldo's course climbs the hillside and is one of the hardest in the area. The online green fee includes a buggy, if one is available.

**[Amendoeira O'Connor](/courses/amendoeira-oconnor)** (par 72, 6,708 m, slope 136): Christy O'Connor Jr.'s sister course stays flat in the valley among orange groves, with the same buggy-included green fee.
Golf at Jupiter Albufeira

Jupiter Albufeira doesn't offer golf services: its website has no golf desk, golf discounts or golf shuttle. It's a hotel for a family holiday with a few rounds, so you'll book tee times directly with the clubs and need a hire car or taxi to get there.

Two practical points for golfers: the hotel's free shuttle only goes to Praia dos Pescadores and the town centre, and parking costs €10 a night from June to September and €6 in other months, unless you book the All-Inclusive PLUS upgrade, which includes it. The standard all-inclusive covers meals and selected drinks at the hotel, a kids' club and a rooftop bar.

content.text: Which course to play from Jupiter Albufeira

**For a quick round,** Balaia and Pine Cliffs are 9-hole courses within about a quarter of an hour. Read [Balaia vs Pine Cliffs](/guide/balaia-vs-pine-cliffs-which-quick-round-near-albufeira-should-you-play).
**For 18 holes,** Salgados is the cheapest nearby, from €78, and Laguna and Millennium start at €88. See [the cheapest golf near Albufeira](/guide/cheapest-golf-near-albufeira).
**Without a car,** see [Algarve golf without a car](/guide/algarve-golf-transfers-without-a-car) for taxis and transfers.
Getting there
Jupiter Albufeira is about **42 minutes and 39 km from Faro Airport** by car, without traffic. See [Faro Airport to Albufeira with golf clubs](/guide/faro-airport-to-albufeira-with-golf-clubs).
Golf near Jupiter Albufeira: common questions
What is the closest golf course to Jupiter Albufeira?
Balaia, a 9-hole par-3 course about 8 minutes away. Pine Cliffs is about 13 minutes away, and the closest 18-hole courses, Salgados, Laguna and Millennium, are about 19.
Does Jupiter Albufeira offer golf packages?
No. Its website doesn't mention golf services, so book your rounds directly with the clubs.
Do I need a handicap to play near Jupiter Albufeira?

At the 18-hole courses, yes, usually up to 28 for men and 36 for ladies. Pine Cliffs doesn't ask for one. See [do you need a handicap to play golf in the Algarve?](/guide/do-you-need-a-handicap-to-play-golf-in-the-algarve)
